results.conclusion: A chosen typed interpretation distinguishes essential bearer power, an act-kind predicate, successive intrinsic act tokens and created effects. It realises possible G-empty and stronger all-emergent-empty alternatives together with box-diamond availability of genuinely fresh, existent G tokens. Its separately chosen actual trajectory has a total emergent gap followed by a distinct new act; every occurring emergent token permanently ceases. A temporally novel intrinsic act can produce a created effect without itself satisfying Created or the model’s ExternalReceipt predicate. Exactly one stipulated object is all-world necessary; this is a representation control, not an actual metaphysical existence or possibility proof.
